## What this is

The chat page polls this while a funding search runs, to draw the progress bar: which step the search is on, what it is doing, and when it last reported. It reads one row from `funding_runs` and does nothing else — no searching, no model calls, no cost.

It answers on `/webhook/funding-progress`, and the chat app asks it a few times a minute, which is why this workflow keeps no execution history: saving several thousand identical successful runs a day would bury the executions list everyone actually reads.
